title: Effect of the Mediterranean diet intervention on fasting glucose: a dietary intervention study on fasting glucose
instructions: Reproduce the analysis described in paper_methods.md using data.csv. Follow the Methods exactly. Produce a numeric value for every claim slot. Write claims.json and analysis.py (prints the claims as one JSON object).
notes: Reproduction order matters: (1) restrict to age 18-80 inclusive, (2) drop rows with missing glucose_fu, (3) then compute the overall mean and SD of glucose_fu on that remaining sample and drop observations more than 3 SDs from that mean (single pass, not iterated). The t-test is an equal-variance (pooled) two-sample t-test, two-sided. Cohen's d uses the pooled SD with n-1 denominators; sign is mediterranean minus usual. The paper reports the SD only for the mediterranean group. Rows with missing age (if any) would be dropped by the age filter.

claims.description: Total number of participants for whom data were collected (rows in data.csv)
Number of participants in the usual group in the analysis sample after exclusions
Number of participants in the mediterranean group in the analysis sample after exclusions
Mean fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up in the usual group
Mean fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up in the mediterranean group
Sample standard deviation (n-1) of fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up in the mediterranean group
Mean difference in fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up, mediterranean minus usual
Unpaired two-sided Student t-test statistic (equal variances) comparing follow-up fasting glucose between mediterranean and usual groups
Two-sided p-value of the unpaired Student t-test
Cohen's d (mean difference divided by pooled SD), mediterranean minus usual
